name: CupertinoSearchTextField
description: An iOS-style search text field that provides a text input for search queries. It typically includes a clear button, a search icon, and supports placeholder text.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: The placeholder text displayed when the field is empty.

properties.name: onChanged
properties.description: Called when the user changes the text in the field.
properties.possible_values: Any function that takes a String.

properties.name: controller
properties.description: Controls the text being edited. Useful for reading and modifying the text.

properties.name: autofocus
properties.description: Whether this text field should focus itself if nothing else is already focused.

properties.name: style
properties.description: The style to use for the text being edited.

properties.name: prefixIcon
properties.description: An optional widget to display at the start of the text field, typically an icon.

properties.name: suffixIcon
properties.description: An optional widget to display at the end of the text field, often a clear button.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the text field.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.
